Current contract: docs/storage-text-format.md. UTF-8/LF sorted JSON per immutable UUID project record, preserved integer API aliases with randomized new allocation, derived task communication numbers and randomized QA labels, UUID foreign-key references, exact multiline chunks, explicit ordering and deletion tombstones. Preserve authoritative project domains and QA evidence; compatibility reads accept schema 14, while successful writes upgrade to schema 15 with canonical Markdown records. Application request history is excluded from Git: retry results, machine paths, intents and execution ownership remain in ignored checkout-local state shared by desktop/MCP. Reads, fresh no-op requests and retries leave tracked bytes and mtimes unchanged; fresh clones have no request history or cross-clone replay guarantee. Version-1 projects remain read-only byte-stable; the next successful content write upgrades the format and removes legacy request files with recoverable journal deletion, retaining local retry results. Conversions emit version 2 and preserve local retry results within the same checkout. Reuse domain validators through a disposable in-memory SQLite projection. SHA-256 resource fingerprints reject stale content despite equal branch counters. Shared local OS lock, before/after journal and atomic replacement protect cooperating clients and interrupted writes; unexpected external edits block recovery. No Git commands or automatic conflict resolution. Full structural/semantic validation rejects markers, invalid references, collisions, duplicate task/QA link positions and unsafe artifacts. O(project size) materialization; external Git writes must remain idle during publication; directory durability is platform dependent. Task 19 verifies real independent-clone Git scenarios and native WebView2/MCP pull, branch, conflict, no-op and migration flows. Native conflict reload preserves drafts without autosaving discarded edits. Evidence and practical limits: docs/storage-git-collaboration.md.

Implemented Markdown extension (2026-09-25; SQLite and text backends): Extend the current version-2 canonical JSON record vocabulary and any explicitly versioned upgrade needed for Markdown records and typed associations. Store complete prose in canonical records using the existing exact multiline representation; generated .md exports never become authoritative text-backend records. Update closed collection/schema inventories, UUID/reference mapping, aliases, tombstones, ordering, semantic validation, resource fingerprints, local receipts, journal recovery, export/import and disposable relational materialization. Preserve stable identities across Git clones and backend conversion; reject merge markers/invalid references and same-resource stale writes rather than auto-merging. Compatibility reads do not rewrite old projects, unchanged files stay byte/mtime-stable, and upgrades occur only via supported explicit/write migration paths. Verify independent edits merge normally and overlapping edits remain visible conflicts. Keep request history and machine-specific output state out of tracked canonical records.

Verification (2026-09-25): Markdown tasks 25-36 implement this extension on the available SQLite and text adapters. Common contracts, actual stdio MCP, native Tauri/WebView2, conversion, independent Git clones and generated-file checks are recorded in task 36, QA jobs 6/7 and docs/markdown-validation.md. Generated files remain derived and agent authoring uses MCP. Server SQL implementation and validation remain pending in storage tasks 20-23.

Text IDs and task communication numbers (2026-09-27; supersedes the 2026-09-25 sequential text-ID correction): Preserve existing permanent IDs and UUID references. Restore randomized numeric allocation for new text-backend records across all numeric collections; SQLite retains its own allocation policy. Detect genuine duplicate identities rather than silently redirect references. Task.number is a derived one-based position over all nondeleted project tasks ordered by created_at ascending, then permanent numeric id ascending. Compute it in shared storage queries before filtering/pagination; desktop and MCP consume the same value. Numbers may change after deletion or Git updates, never identify persisted links/history, and do not affect resource guards. MCP get accepts taskNumber as an alternative to taskId, optionally guarded by the observed project revision; subsequent mutations require the resolved permanent taskId and task version. Text format 3 omits task number from canonical records; versions 1/2 remain readable without writes and upgrade on successful writes. QA's stored number uses independent randomized allocation in text storage. Read-only opens preserve tracked bytes. Verify independent-clone memo/task/QA creation and merging, numbering/filter/page/get parity, stale number lookup, stable references and migration.
